scope: Classic 1996 English base game, publisher PDF pages 1–12, including every base Action Card; excludes expansions pages 13–20, later editions and optional short game.
method: Read all allowed source passages, including PDF text and illustrated card-face text extracted with pypdf; compare each of Q01–Q53 with its key and source; challenge omissions without reading summaries, readers, grades or prior review files. The ledger was used to identify existing targets and rejected candidates, not as proof of source support.

verdict.reason: No meaningful additional rule, resolved outcome branch or timing exception survives comparison with the existing 53 targets. This independently supports the latest two zero-addition passes. Several reachable mandatory-action branches have no executable resolution in the supplied source, so saturation cannot establish complete-core gameplay coverage.

findings.finding: The question bank covers all distinct explained base-card procedures, including each Intrigue ownership/origin/destination allowance, Veto retention and interruption, forced returns, all scoring selectors, mobile introduction/relocation, Royal Adviser, forced secret Movement, Grande relocation, power recovery, Court replenishment and the King card. Repeated card printings do not create new targets.

Q47 and Q49 retain source-specific other-region wording. Q44 alone has the explicit permission to return some Caballeros to the original region. No new comparison question is warranted because these destination branches are already tested.
Q52 tests the secret-disk selectable domain and King-region scoring exception; Q53 tests both mobile-scoreboard state transitions. These are present in v4 and cannot be counted again.

Supported-target saturation and a source-complete playable ruleset are separate outcomes. The unresolved mandatory-return and protected-only cases below prevent a complete-core PASS even though they cannot supply definitive new answer-key targets.

key_audit.result: All 53 keys checked against pp.1–12; no correction required within their stated conditions. Q29 correctly exposes rather than conceals the King returns heading/detail discrepancy. Q31–Q33 do not resolve protected-only/no-eligible branches; Q42 does not supply a shortage fallback. Do not extend these keys beyond the supported cases.

checked_passages.passage: Contents, object, board description; full standard preparation: Castillo, shuffled region cards, distinct King/home allocation, Grandes, initial ten Caballeros, provinces/courts, secret disks, own power-card sets, separately shuffled 1–5 action stacks, mobile scoreboards beside board. Short-game instructions excluded.

Round marker starts at one; later advances; five actions revealed before power selection; first starter chosen, later previous last player; clockwise face-up distinct power values; used-stack visibility and retention; descending turn order.

Recruit up to pictured amount before selecting available action; board supplement for province shortage; optional ordinary deployment max, adjacent current King/Castillo, free splitting; complete special action before/after deployment; chosen card unavailable later; remaining cards discarded; recurring King card.

King-region taboo covers Caballeros/Grande/mobile board; only King-moving actions alter it; scoring allowed; King bonus for sole leader; Castillo entry independent of King, announce amount, exits only general scoring.

General scoring after rounds 3/6/9; choose disks face down before opening Castillo, score Castillo, reveal and transfer all own to one region, illegal King choice to court, fully empty/replace Castillo, score regions in track order and move score markers.

Caballero majority ignores Grandes; normal three rank values; two/three-player rank limits; tied rank shifts down one; explicit multiway-first and tied-third examples; home/King bonuses on sole majority including special scorings; end after third general scoring, furthest marker wins.

All-card rules A–G: absolute taboo with scoring exception, simultaneous secret disk choices, Castillo entry/exit, indivisible activities in either order, maximum numbers, ordinary versus special destinations, optional special action/card denial.

All eleven 1-stack cards: ordinary max one; all-own single-origin with explicit return permission; two extra court deployment; exclusive either/or; two five-from-one cards; foreign-three; mixed-three; two separate own-two/foreign-two cards; own-four; mixed-four. Checked different any/other destination wording and all ownership/origin limits.

2-stack ordinary max two; two Veto cards: hold openly, one special only, ordinary placement protected, announcement/interruption/remainder, no completed-action veto, immediate discard or next-round expiration.

Both Decay cards with zero/shortfall court branches; King returns heading versus detailed paragraph/card face, left-of-actor clockwise order and excluded sources; actor-picked one from each including own.

Secret opponent return-two eligibility/singleton fallback and taboo; secret opponent all-from-one selection minimum and no-region-pieces exemption; simultaneous disks; three unrestricted one-location scoring cards include King and Castillo. Completes eleven 2-stack cards.

3-stack ordinary max three; two all-four cards with mobile-board category replacement and bonuses, two all-five cards and explicit Castillo exclusion, six/seven selector, two Castillo-only scorings that retain pieces.

Remaining 3-stack cards: first-place-only with tied-first/no-other-rank and Castillo exclusions; most-region and least-nonempty-region ties with Castillo exclusions; unrestricted chosen-location scoring, re-cover Castillo. Completes eleven 3-stack cards.

4-stack ordinary max four; three mobile-scoreboard cards introduce unused or relocate existing, allow Castillo, forbid King in/out, stacking and alternate orientation; Royal Adviser at most neighboring region; actor picks forced Movement origin, opponents choose secret single destinations, invalid King/origin choice to court.

Remaining 4-stack cards: two Grande moves with forbidden source/destinations and home update, two power recoveries including current turn/visibility, Court province-to-court two, unique-secret scoring with collisions. Completes eleven 4-stack cards.
Sole 5-stack King card: max five ordinary deployment, optional special, King may be put in any region except Castillo; ordering changes current adjacency.

source_limits.issue: King returns requires three own Caballeros from court and/or unprotected regions but gives no insufficient-eligible-pieces fallback. The adjacent Decay paragraph has an explicit shortage rule that this card lacks.
source_limits.effect: Essential reachable mandatory-action branch; no definitive new answer target; blocks complete-core PASS.

source_limits.issue: Send-one-from-each requires a regional Caballero of every player, including actor, while King/Castillo are forbidden; it does not say what happens when a player has no eligible regional piece. Courts are not an authorized source.
source_limits.effect: Essential reachable mandatory-action branch; cannot borrow a court or assume a skip as an authoritative ruling.

source_limits.issue: Secret return-two defines a region with two pieces and a singleton fallback, but does not give a valid choice/removal procedure when there are no eligible pieces or all pieces are protected. Its fellow-players heading versus all-players disk sentence also leaves actor disk participation imprecise.
source_limits.effect: Do not invent a legal disk choice, transfer or actor-loss rule; essential protected-only branch blocks complete-core PASS.

source_limits.issue: Secret all-from-one exempts a player with no pieces in any region, but does not resolve a player whose only regional pieces are in the taboo King region; the required nonempty selection and forbidden source cannot both be satisfied. Heading/detail also differ between fellow players and all players.
source_limits.effect: No definitive protected-only ruling; essential mandatory branch remains incomplete.

source_limits.issue: General Castillo entry permission says any added/moved Caballeros may enter, while forced Movement requires another region selected on disks that omit Castillo. No override/alternate declaration mechanism is specified.
source_limits.effect: Preserve source tension; Q40 covers explicit disk resolution, not a definitive Castillo-destination ruling.

source_limits.issue: All-four scoring uses current first scoreboard value; mobile scoreboard may be placed at Castillo, but all-four does not explicitly include/exclude a Castillo carrying 4/0/0. All-five explicitly excludes Castillo.
source_limits.effect: Do not infer a definite all-four Castillo outcome from silence.

source_limits.issue: The Court says move two from provinces to court, but supplies no explicit fallback if fewer than two remain, nor an explicit board-recruitment permission for this special action.
source_limits.effect: Do not import the power-recruitment shortage rule as a definitive answer.

source_limits.issue: No final-score tie-breaker, Veto-against-Veto resolution, or explicit King-card same-location ruling is supplied.
source_limits.effect: These cannot become definitive new targets; final-score tie remains an unresolved game-outcome branch.
